Folio — the curated theme set

Home regenerated per theme from the six swatches each face authors. Nine families × two separately painted faces = eighteen faces, no two of which share a palette.

Applied in this build: the field ramp is chromatic on ink and a value ramp on paper (a value ramp on a near-black page buys only 20/255, which is why the gradient could not be seen); and the guilloche is built to the numerical spec — audited, the previous ribbons were 3.7–4.9× too wide (the dominant spanned 0.92 of the canvas against 0.16–0.24), which produced both symptoms at once: no negative space, and threads too spread to have density. Now 0.20/0.13/0.05 of the canvas, 32/20/8 threads, a gentler 0.577+0.423exp taper, three explicit classes (fine 0.15 / medium 0.25 / hero 0.60), a hero-only halo at 0.18 with the rest at 0.03, and the plate now confined to a band at y 0.39–0.72 rather than spread over the screen — which is what makes the ribbon silhouette readable at a glance; and the content tiles and chart bars now draw from four different hue families of the theme instead of being one hue at four/four heights; the plate's three hues are chosen for separation rather than list order (abyss dark: 183/195/290, 13° apart, → 183/290/34, 104° apart) and the renderer draws all three instead of one; the light plate is deepened 0.30 toward the ink; the crown is a gradient band with the name reversed out, deepened hard on paper (0.12–0.48) and only at the foot on ink (0.02–0.40) because darkening a luminous signature on a near-black page costs the very contrast the crown is for; the nav capsule wears the crown's colour so the two ends of the screen agree; and the hero pane on a dark face 0.46 → 0.62.

build marker: masthead — if you cannot see the wordmark in colour on the Home sheets, you are looking at a cached copy.
